ver 0.69 Alpha 6894
2008 

Many undocument changes
Now 3 versions Debug / Release / Metal_tuned

known bugs
	INTERNAL
		loading a texture don't update channel_nb or size
	if you disable generate mimap in the texture pref
		set force_linear to ON
		exit and restart AAASeed so you don't get white instead of texture
	if video is deinterlaced the video will not be transfered on the cpu side
	fbo update of gnerate mipmap or stuff on cpu can be bogus in multiple screen
		
bbd_boid
	Changed a lot, extended a lot
	Physics corrected
	now handle several boid interacting in the same universe
cpu
	detect multimedia extension : MMX to SSE4
ftd2
	this objet in tracker can control external relay thru a fred mauclere built interface
	used to pilot stroboscope for now 
def_bdd_uv
	added, transform xyz space in the uv space 
	very useful in particular to refine locally an adjustable grid	
snapshot
	can now save texture
print_master
	printing is now an print_master object, can print from texture
	there is now a print_trig to print a snapshot on the default printer
def_spiral
	refined interface was changed and extended
bdd_ftdi
	new tracker to control fred usb In/Out ftdi box
bdd_ui_pref
	now as a full bdd, there was only a master before
bdd_analyse
	change the definition of the active rect
pref_ui
	cpu info
	OpenGL info
	dll info
	mem stats for alloc, realloc and free
	new Print master object in others
	Save can now save from a texture instead of a snapshot
trax
	added CURVE_BY_NAME
	added ASCII_EQUAL_CONTROL
bdd_tri
	svg import : path and polygon supported, others types or elements are ignored
	svg import : tesselation
	obj export
	draw contours for svg imports
	transform points is now a param bool, to optimize display
tex_video
	support wmv3 playback with directshow
	force enum added to force to "mono 8" "RGB 24" or "RGB 32"
		will work for capture and video
	capture fly included
		also with firefly color and grasshopper color
	restart_trig now set on first image even if not playing
	now incrust is done also in yuyv and uyvy mode
	the cpu copy had red and blue swapped
map
	there is now a minification magnification group instead od lod
		lod is inside
		minification/magnification can now be force there so locally this can change
	add tex_by_side do use a pinpoint strategy
	add a restart_trig for the mapping speed
state
	introduced in module
		state of module cur accessible thru 's' key
		's' key again switch to snapshot
		save states (only the layers) in "toto.state.xxx" where www is the state index
		the directory module ("toto") have state 0 and the module objects which are absent from the others
	there is a state_sensible flag in group (layers)
bdd_image
	a lot done for multitouch
	bdd_image_gradient refined and extended to radial and color bar
multitouch
	bdd_contour
	bdd_tracking
	send tracking info as string ( -> LopArt Multitouch )
render
	add new color mode
group
	fbo can now be set to "Once"
sound_input
	param got reorganized
	setting enable on/off work now
bdd_curve_edit
	is now back to "usable" in 1D
	and save curves correctly
bdd_part
	can now ease alpha on sorted values
	redid color stuff
Bdd
	more object support multiple mode	
layer
	feedback removed now only bdd_
shader
	all uniform are now aaa_ (eg aaa_tex_size)
	uniform for texture size now in
	uniform for ligths on added
	documentation on uniform created : shader_uniform.txt
aka remote added
	iphone aka remote program supported
	http://akamatsu.org/repo.xml
bdd_adjustable_grid
	alpha for grid
	cleaned debugged
	now you can change the resolution of the control point
		and keep the deformation
	if grid inherit last it now inherit the u v numbers too
lua
	get app directory
	load images from script, does not replace names in bind
	set video time
	get image pixel color from xy and uv
camera
	alignments are back
	cup in the interface
		
INTERFACE
	key 's' now switch from Snapshot to State control of the current module		
	non edit mode now more ^protected (F3 and F4 now out)
INTERNAL
	fbo
		floating point texture are back fp16 and fp32
		option to grab color attachement to cpu when fbo render is done
		now support up to 8 color attachment, check against nb from videocard driver
	boid
		redone and refined
	nvcpl stop if driver number can't be read
		this way AAASeed don't stop with recent Nvidia driver on vista e.g. 169.25 
	tex_video
		now support monochrome flux
		direct show improved (force_32bit for rgba)
		try to avoid locking flux in directshow
		grab first image when starting aaaseed
		force format in for directshow videos ( No, Mono, RGB 24, RGB 32 )
		graph filters are now properly destroyed when rebuilding graph when changing force in format
	shader
		uniforms cleanup
		multitexture done better
	tex
		add glGetTexImage to grab a full texture, could be use when grabbing fbo ( same as read_pixels but for a whole texture )
	tex_anim
		corrected a phase bug for multiple
	texture switch
		cleaned, optimized, size kept at tex:: level
		tex and bind_image cleaner faster and better
		minification magnification cleaned
	multitexture
		map::cur only on texture 0
	vfile naming redone to be relative
		fx.aaa_layers_all can now be moved with no renaming inside the file
	mutiple now have a default process in bdd_multiple base on get_point() fn
	src tree redone
	passing texture size now ok for shader
		at least for the standard texture
	adapted to visual 2008
	debug version can run separated
	using SVN instead of source safe
	project cleaned
	state
		state_sensitive added at param level
	net
		better osc support
			most osc infact is out (lemur, kronde...)
		avoid crash when switching net to off
		options to open udp socket to send only
	action
		more things doine thru the action mecanism
	cpu
		Multimedia extension detection redone using code from Microsoft and intrinsic cpuid()
		cpu is now a namespace n_cpu

ver 0.69 Beta 67 "Post Aichi/Pre Scopitone"
11 Juin 2005

COMPATIBILITY ISSUE
once saved don't try to use your AAAASeed Env with previous version
	local traxs are now saved as .trax instead of .traxl
		so delete .traxl when saved the first time because if they exist .traxl are read instead
	layers saved before a list in .layers (fx_a, fx_b....)
		if the .layers file exists it's used to load but save alway do fx_a,fx_b...
		so delete .layers when saved the first time
	
def_interpolate
	works now with boid particle and null
bdd_boid
	have being improved and extended
bdd_uv
	can now be interpolated to
midi
	param allow_Non_Registered_Parameter_Number added for Behringer BCF2000n and BCR2000
	mackie control are now in channel 16 controller 1 to 64 
	double h + a autoconnect the next midi event to the cur parameter thru a free trax
	double h + b disconnect the current parameter
mackie
	add midi patches for the mackie control univesal
	add store in the param interface
	start to use the behringer as replacement
trax
	DISTANCE_3D can now have only one input

DV in now functionnal

	Edit en haut a gauche des params se deplace

	bug midi cleaned up
